builds.goal: Reference for Renekton: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A Fury-managed melee fighter who selects an empowered stun, healing sweep or armor shred and uses two dashes to shape trades. Fix Fury and empowered W/Q choice. Crit/attack effects must be verified on W's current hits; E armor reduction and shielding counters matter more than a pre-stacked burst screenshot. Stridebreaker access and conditional Sundered Sky sustain may buy time for repeated kit damage.
builds.summary: Stridebreaker access and conditional Sundered Sky sustain may buy time for repeated kit damage.
testPlan: Kit question for Renekton: Fix Fury and empowered W/Q choice. Crit/attack effects must be verified on W's current hits; E armor reduction and shielding counters matter more than a pre-stacked burst screenshot.

Start with the early core (Stridebreaker, then Sundered Sky) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Resource: Fury. Do not treat mana regeneration as Fury recovery; Nimbus replaces Manaflow when that Sorcery row is used.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Stridebreaker access and conditional Sundered Sky sustain may buy time for repeated kit damage. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Renekton swings his blade, dealing moderate physical damage to all targets around him, and heals for a small portion of the damage dealt. If he has more than 50 Fury, his damage and heal are increased. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Physical pressure or sustained contact must justify these purchases; MR and healing slots are matchup dependent.

The route fails Renekton's stated kit question: Fix Fury and empowered W/Q choice. Crit/attack effects must be verified on W's current hits; E armor reduction and shielding counters matter more than a pre-stacked burst screenshot.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Physical pressure or sustained contact must justify these purchases; MR and healing slots are matchup dependent.
Full cost 16,800 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Stridebreaker, then Sundered Sky. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Sterak's Gage, Death's Dance, Spirit Visage are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Resource: Fury. Do not treat mana regeneration as Fury recovery; Nimbus replaces Manaflow when that Sorcery row is used.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

kitEvidence.formula:
Renekton's next Attack strikes twice, Stunning for [0.75] seconds and dealing a total of [(5 / 20 / 35 / 50 / 65 + (0.75) × AD) × (2)] physical damage. Hitting a champion generates an additional [10] Fury.

Fury Bonus: Renekton Attacks 3 times instead, destroying Shields before dealing [(5 / 20 / 35 / 50 / 65 + (0.75) × AD) × (3)] physical damage and Stunning for [1.5] seconds. Does not generate any Fury.

Renekton gains [5] Fury per Attack. While above [50] Fury, his next Ability spends it to become empowered. Fury decays while out of combat.

While below [50]% Health, Renekton gains [50]% increased Fury.

Renekton dashes, dealing [40 / 70 / 100 / 130 / 160 + (0.9) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage. He generates [2] Fury per non-champion and [10] Fury per champion hit. Hitting at least one enemy allows Renekton to Recast this Ability once for [4] seconds. 

Fury Bonus: The Recast dash deals [70 / 115 / 160 / 205 / 250 + (1.35) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage instead and removes [25 / 27.5 / 30 / 32.5 / 35]% Armor for [4] seconds. Does not generate Fury.

Renekton swings his blade, dealing [60 / 90 / 120 / 150 / 180 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage and restoring [2 / 3 / 4 / 5 / 6 + (0.02) × AD[statFormula=2]] Health per non-champion and [12 / 20 / 28 / 36 / 44 + (0.17) × AD[statFormula=2]] per champion hit. He also generates [2.5] Fury per non-champion and [10] Fury per champion.

Fury Bonus: Damage is increased to [90 / 135 / 180 / 225 / 270 + (1.4) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage and healing is increased to [(2 / 3 / 4 / 5 / 6 + (0.02) × AD[statFormula=2]) × (3)] Health against non-champions and [(12 / 20 / 28 / 36 / 44 + (0.17) × AD[statFormula=2]) × (3)] Health against champions. Does not generate any Fury.

Renekton surrounds himself with dark energies for [15] seconds, gaining [300 / 500 / 700] max Health and [20] Fury. While active, he deals [60 / 150 / 240 + (0.1) × AP + (0.1) × AD[statFormula=2]] magic damage and gains [5] Fury per second.
